payload.blocks: Phase 2a (delete src/setup/agent-hooks.mjs) and through it 2b. Every other open phase continues.
payload.headline: Phase 2a: how do the mailbox test harnesses install a workspace's agent hooks once the Node table is gone?

parts.cause: wire-agents only plans a person's global agent config and never writes .claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json or .<cli>/extensions (wire_agents.rs:48-56, agent_config.rs:772). The Rust door that writes them, agent_hooks::install_hook, is reached only through doctor's fix of rows claude/codex/omp/pi-hook-wired (doctor/packaging.rs:245), and fgos doctor --fix takes no row: it runs every fix on the cwd. Report: reports/unit-261123-1952-p2a-result.md.

options.cost: About 60 lines plus generated contracts, in 2a.
options.does: fgos doctor --fix gains --only <row-id> (repeatable). The harnesses call fgos doctor --fix --only claude-hook-wired (and codex, omp, pi) through invokeHost with the workspace as dir; checkClaudeHook becomes the claude-hook-wired check row. Then 2a deletes the Node table as planned.
options.gain: Reuses the one registered fix door, adds no install mechanism, and gives users a way to repair one row.
options.harm: A new doctor flag: the host command contracts, registry and doctor wiring join 2a's files. The hook fix must accept a temporary workspace; if its project-root rule refuses one, the unit stops again.
options.label: A. Let doctor --fix take one row

options.does: fgos wire-agents gains a target that installs the four project hook rows in --dir; the harnesses call it.
options.gain: Matches the phase's wording (wire-agents is the named survivor).
options.harm: Mixes a person's global config verb with per-project files that doctor already owns, a second door onto install_hook.
options.label: B. Give wire-agents a project-hooks target

options.does: 2a stops; phase 10 names agent-hook-table as debt with retiredBy the mailbox re-measure (p-irt4weqipe), which re-points the harnesses later.
options.harm: Overrides the owner's earlier 'deleted either way'; the Node twin and 2b stay open past this plan.
options.label: C. Keep the Node table as named debt

parts.recommendation: A: it reuses the doctor fix that already owns these files, and a one-row fix is useful outside the tests.

scope.allows: For A: adding --only to fgos doctor --fix and its contracts, and adding the doctor wiring and contract files to phase 2a's files, only for this.
scope.forbids: Any other doctor behaviour change, a new verb, or changing what install_hook writes.

parts.what: The 2a unit (c-304716) stopped at step 3 with nothing changed. The harnesses (scripts/lib/mailbox-live-confined.mjs and the two test/live scripts) install Claude, Codex, omp and pi hook rows into a temporary workspace through the Node table. The phase says to move them to fgos wire-agents, which cannot do that.
